steps.name: BACKUP DATABASE (offline)
steps.cmd: __o=$(mktemp); ( su - db2inst1 -c 'for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do db2 force applications all >/dev/null; sleep 1; db2 deactivate db lab >/dev/null; if db2 -v '"'"'backup db lab to /backups compress without prompting'"'"'; then break; fi; sleep 2; done' ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 6 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc

backup db lab to /backups compress without prompting
